skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts of environmental chemistry including air, water, and soil components.
Understand the structure of the atmosphere and its pollutants.
Analyze mechanisms of air pollution and their effects.
Manage water resources and understand natural water cycles.
Assess water quality using basic parameters and principles.
Understand the chemical composition of soil and its pollutants.
Study carbon, oxygen, nitrogen, phosphorus, sulfur, and heavy metal cycles in nature.
Develop research, analysis, synthesis, and generalization skills related to environmental chemistry.
Work independently and collaboratively to solve problems.
Possess the ability to learn independently, seek information, and conduct research on relevant topics.
Maintain classroom discipline, follow class rules, and have a cooperative and responsible attitude towards activities assigned by instructors.
